headline: Customers Bank says an AI pilot closed select commercial loans in seven days
body: Customers Bank said a pilot of its AI loan process closed select commercial loans in seven days, against a typical 30 to 60 days. Its parent, Customers Bancorp, said on Oct. 22 that it is scaling the process and estimated more than $15 million in annualized capacity.
note: Employees said in a survey that they saved an estimated 76,000 cumulative hours, up nearly 65% from the second quarter.
correction: Note said the hours saved came from a survey and added a 5% to 10% full-return figure that the source scopes to large U.S. companies in financial services, healthcare and media, from a separate PYMNTS survey, and that 'The hours saved' had no antecedent. Note now states only the bank's employee survey figure, as the source does.

evidence.text: Commercial loans can take weeks to close, and Pennsylvania-based Customers Bank put its typical wait at 30 to 60 days.
A pilot of its artificial intelligence (AI)-powered process closed select commercial loans in seven days, the bank said in July in its Q2 earnings release.
Customers Bancorp, the bank’s parent with more than $27 billion in assets, said Thursday (Oct. 22) for its Q3 earnings results that it is scaling the process.
Customers Bancorp also estimated more than $15 million in annualized capacity, which it counts as salary and benefits savings from positions not backfilled and open positions reduced this year.
Customers Bank employees said in a survey that they saved an estimated 76,000 cumulative hours, up nearly 65% from the second quarter.
Among large U.S. companies in financial services, healthcare and media, between 90% and 100% report some return on new AI tools.
Only 5% to 10% report a full return, according to the PYMNTS Intelligence report “The Enterprise AI Payback Curve: Adoption Accelerates as Returns Take Shape.”
